adaptationSummary: Configured a shared local Supabase stack (Postgres, Auth, REST, Studio, Mailpit via the Supabase CLI) as the harness's single shared dependency for all agent slots, replacing the generic per-slot Postgres+MinIO/docker-compose model. setup-infra.sh starts/resolves Supabase once via the CLI into .har/state/supabase.env (fixed ports 54321-54324), reused by every slot; docker-compose.agent.yml is now intentionally empty since the Supabase CLI manages its own containers. Added an idempotent demo login, readiness.sh (Layer 4 'agent usable' smoke: signs up a real user against the shared Auth API to prove the running frontend is wired to Supabase), a liveness-only /api/health route excluded from auth middleware, and disabled unused Supabase services (realtime/storage/edge_runtime/analytics). Rewrote harness.env, launch.sh, agent-slot.sh, agent-cli.sh, teardown.sh, verify.sh, env.template, ecosystem.agent.template.cjs, README.md, and CLAUDE.agent.md for the single-process Next.js + shared-Supabase model. Also fixed two pre-existing app issues blocking npm run lint (require()-style tailwind plugin import, eslint scanning .next/.har generated output). Verified end-to-end: launch, verify --full (typecheck+health+lint+readiness all pass), agent-cli status/url/health/psql/exec/reset-db, and teardown all work correctly against a live local Supabase stack.
